purpose: Pass on information you have heard or read.
keywords: Plain clause + そうだ; noun / な-adjective + だそうだ.
According to the forecast, it will rain tomorrow.
I hear Ms. Tanaka is well.
I hear this shop has been here for a hundred years.
formation: Plain clause + そうだ; noun / な-adjective + だそうだ.
restrictions: Identify or imply an information source; this is not visual appearance そうだ.
mistake: Keep plain だ after noun predicates for reported information.
